title: Pure Fur Hire
summary: Fur Hire cards with generic staples; the page itself argues for the pure build. Each small Fur Hire summons another from the hand, and gets its own bonus (a search, a pop, a recycle) whenever another Fur Hire is Special Summoned next to it, so every summon chains into more. The Burst Protocol cards lead: Whirlwind Fur Hire summons from the Deck on an empty field, Rex, Ride brings a second Fur Hire with it, Keel Sets a Fur Hire Spell/Trap, and Furtive Techniques destroys a card per differently named Fur Hire. Folgo draws up to three when their cards are destroyed.
